content.comment_body: Hello everyone, The [product_name] [version_no] offers a useful feature called DataLogCreate, which enables automatic data logging. Is there a similar function in [product_name] software that could automatically generate a data file? Ideally, I'd like to access the data later via a web server. Any suggestions or advice would be greatly appreciated. Thank you!
Currently, [product_name] does not include this feature. However, around October 2020, a new [product_name] [version_no] with cloud data logging functionality was released.

All [product_name] [article_no] models offer the Data Log function block. This allows data to be logged in a specified [product_name] area, of up to 1024 bytes. Alternatively, data logs can be saved as CSV files on an inserted mSD card. Another option is to use a PC running [product_name] Access Tool, which integrates as an Excel Add-In.
Thank you all for your quick replies. I just want to confirm—so right now, there is no way to automatically log data from [product_name] directly to a server?

That's correct, there is no solution for web server access. A Data Log saved on an mSD card can only be read using [product_name] software. If there are multiple Data Logs on the mSD card, only the most recent one can be read, and it requires switching [product_name] to stop mode before reading. Alternatively, you can physically remove the mSD card and view Data Logs on your PC.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are looking for an automatic data logging feature in [product_name] devices similar to DataLogCreate in [product_name] [version_no], with the preference to access logs via a web server. Presently, data logging is available using the Data Log function or [product_name] Access Tool, but solutions require manual mSD card extraction or a PC, without integrated remote or web-based access.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want [product_name] products to support integrated, automatic data logging, preferably with remote or web server access to stored data files.
